description.text: Root files for the first create, including LICENSE from the module license and a slim .gitignore. src/global.json is optional and unchecked by default. version.json is not a checkbox here; choose This repository on a first create to add the root file. Visual Studio requires at least one value; choose None when adding another module to the same repository.

Where this module's .slnx is written. Default src/sln/{name}/ with the handbook beside that file. Other locations: repository root, or src/prj/{name}/ next to the module csproj. Several .slnx files in the same folder make `dotnet` require an explicit path (MSB1011).

Choose PowerShell hosts, not raw .NET versions. Default ships the broadly compatible Windows PowerShell 5.1 binary on .NET Framework 4.6.2 plus the broadly compatible PowerShell 7.4+ binary on .NET 8. PowerShell 7.6 can load the .NET 8 binary; select .NET Framework 4.8 or .NET 10 only when their newer API surfaces are needed.
Checked values write explicit C# and debug properties on the module, tests, benchmark, and debug host. XML documentation is module-only. Uncheck one to write the alternative.

Default is This module (Properties/version.json) on every create. This repository writes root version.json on a first create; later modules keep This repository and choose None for root items. Off keeps VersionPrefix in the module project.

Adds Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.PublicApiAnalyzers to the binary module assembly. The first build writes Properties/PublicAPI baseline files if they are missing. Test, benchmark, and debug-host projects are not affected.

Optional DocShell.html seed. Module docs go under this module's Properties/ModuleAssets/docs and stage with the PowerShell module. Repository docs go under docs/ at the repo root (first create only). Choose None when adding another module unless you only want module docs.
Default MIT. The selected License.txt is staged with the PowerShell module; the optional repository-root LICENSE copies it.

name.text: Code style rules for module project

description.text: Single choice. Default is Strict: naming, XML docs, nullable, unused usings, and reserved identifiers (CA1716) fail the module build. Default (style suggestions) is the same dump without those errors. Off writes no file.
SDK CA rules on the binary module only. Default Recommended. Minimum is fewer warnings. All is almost every CA rule. Separate from code style Strict and Public API analyzers.

name.text: Treat high/critical NuGet vulnerabilities as errors

description.text: Default on. Restore fails the module project on high (NU1903) and critical (NU1904) vulnerable packages. Low and moderate stay warnings. Uncheck for an EOL or backport graph. The dependency report next to the tests remains informational.

Single choice. Default is Coverlet: dotnet test fails below 100% line, branch, and method coverage on the library. Edit Threshold in the test csproj if you want less. Coverlet and ReportGenerator also writes HTML/Markdown. None writes no extra test packages. ReportGenerator needs Coverlet output, so the two are not independent checkboxes.
Default off. Writes empty Directory.Build.props and Directory.Build.targets beside this module, and Directory.Solution.props and Directory.Solution.targets beside this module's .slnx.
Default on. Writes an empty .config/dotnet-tools.json beside this module (no tools). Landing file for dotnet tool install --local. Uncheck to skip.
